verdict.rationale: Token2 ships software (desktop and mobile companion apps, the fido2-manage CLI/GUI, and browser tools), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question. The pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking, or any way to disable them. The TOTP toolset's note that computation is local and no seed is sent to a server is about secret handling, not usage tracking, so it does not evidence an opt-out.
